title: Madhya Pradesh Police Act, 2007
eligibility: All residents and visitors in Madhya Pradesh
benefits: Establishment of transparent police accountability mechanisms
Protection of citizen rights during investigation and detention
application_process: Step 1: File complaint online via MP Police Citizen Portal or at local Police Station.
Step 2: Obtain free copy of FIR.
important_sections_or_clauses: Section 34: Duty of police officers regarding community policing and public safety
Section 52: Police Complaints Authority setup at State and District levels
